title: Kurt Bauer’s still life photographs reveal more about a place than a “postcard view” ever could

paragraphs.text: The Austrian photographer captures overlooked details and fleeting moments, making you incredibly curious about what’s going on just out of frame.
paragraphs.translation: 這位奧地利攝影師捕捉被忽視的細節與稍縱即逝的瞬間，讓你對畫框之外發生的事情感到無比好奇。

paragraphs.text: The title of Kurt Bauer’s self-published portfolio of works from the past six years is Turista per Sempre (Forever a Tourist) – a phrase that quite fittingly reflects the Austrian photographer’s approach: “looking at places with the mindset of a visitor, whether far from home or just around the corner”, the photographer says. For Kurt, the art of image making has always been a way to stay attentive to what unfolds around him and to notice details that not everyone records. “What interests me most is the possibility of seeing the ordinary anew,” he says. “I often find myself returning to subjects that are easy to overlook – small traces of human presence, objects shaped by time, or moments when light briefly transforms an everyday scene into something unexpected.”
paragraphs.translation: 庫爾特·鮑爾（Kurt Bauer）自出版的過去六年作品集標題為《永遠的遊客》（Turista per Sempre）——這個短語恰如其分地反映了這位奧地利攝影師的方法：「無論是遠離家鄉還是就在轉角處，都以遊客的心態觀察地方，」攝影師說。對庫爾特而言，影像創作藝術一直是他保持對周遭事物關注並注意到那些並非每個人都會記錄的細節的一種方式。「我最感興趣的是重新審視平凡事物的可能性，」他說。「我經常發現自己回到那些容易被忽視的主題——人類存在的微小痕跡、受時間形塑的物體，或是光線短暫地將日常場景轉化為意想不到之物的時刻。」

paragraphs.text: Rather than describing a place directly, Kurt’s still life scenes tend to feel like fragments of something larger at play. They do one thing very well – they make you incredibly curious about what’s sitting just beyond the frame. To achieve such a level of intrigue, Kurt is able to capture a story trapped somewhat within a singular moment: an untouched drink left on a table; an abandoned towel by the pool; or the remains of someone’s dinner spilt down a style of shoe that might tell us a lot about their character. His background in art direction and visual storytelling comes through in these seemingly pre-planned compositions – transferring his carefully constructed studio images to these quick observations made on the move.
paragraphs.translation: 庫爾特的靜物場景並非直接描述一個地方，而是傾向於讓人感覺像是某個更宏大運作中的片段。它們把一件事做得非常好——讓妳對畫框之外的事物感到極度好奇。為了達到這種引人入勝的程度，庫爾特能夠捕捉到困在單一瞬間內的故事：桌上沒動過的飲料、泳池旁遺棄的毛巾，或是某人晚餐殘渣灑在一種可能透露出其性格的鞋款上。他在藝術指導和視覺敘事方面的背景體現在這些看似預先規劃的構圖中——將他精心設計的棚拍影像轉化為這些在行進中捕捉的快速觀察。

paragraphs.text: “Regardless of the setting,” he says, “I’m interested in paying close attention and allowing room for chance. I’m drawn to photographs that leave room for ambiguity and allow memory, observation and imagination to overlap.” It’s through these movie-like shots that he aims to frame images that “tell me more about a place than a postcard view ever could,” he ends.
paragraphs.translation: 「無論環境如何，」他說，「我都對保持密切關注並為偶然留出空間感興趣。我被那些留有模糊空間，並讓記憶、觀察與想像力重疊的照片所吸引。」正是通過這些電影般的鏡頭，他旨在框取那些「比明信片風景更能告訴我關於一個地方的故事」的影像，他最後說道。

paragraphs.text: Ellis Tree (she/her) is a staff writer at It’s Nice That. She joined as a junior writer in April 2024 after graduating from Kingston School of Art with a degree in Graphic Design. Across her research, writing and visual work she has a particular interest in printmaking, self-publishing and expanded approaches to photography. ert@itsnicethat.com
paragraphs.translation: 艾莉絲·特里（Ellis Tree，她）是 It’s Nice That 的職員作家。她在 2024 年 4 月從金斯頓藝術學院獲得平面設計學位後加入，擔任初級作家。在她的研究、寫作和視覺作品中，她對版畫製作、自出版以及攝影的延伸方法特別感興趣。ert@itsnicethat.com

paragraphs.text: To submit your work to be featured on the site, see our Submissions Guide.
paragraphs.translation: 若要提交您的作品以在網站上展示，請參閱我們的投稿指南。

paragraphs.text: Hannah Motzel Brown’s shadowy mechanical pencil drawings expertly depict fingers, freckles and folds of skin
paragraphs.translation: 漢娜·莫策爾·布朗陰影重重的自動鉛筆畫專業地描繪了手指、雀斑和皮膚褶皺

paragraphs.text: One person’s rubbish is another’s treasure: This folded photo series transforms trash into objects worthy of still life
paragraphs.translation: 一個人的垃圾是另一個人的寶藏：這個摺疊照片系列將垃圾轉化為值得作為靜物拍攝的物件

paragraphs.text: Forget found materials, Anaïs Odoux is colouring each piece of her constructivist collages by hand
paragraphs.translation: 忘掉現成材料吧，安娜伊絲·歐杜正在手工為她的構成主義拼貼作品的每一部分上色

paragraphs.text: This candy-filled photo series takes corner shop staples and turns them into luxury items
paragraphs.translation: 這個充滿糖果的照片系列將雜貨店的主打產品變成了奢侈品

paragraphs.text: Let Janice Chan’s photographs of a Chinese kite festival blow you away
paragraphs.translation: 讓珍妮絲·陳拍攝的中國風箏節照片令你驚嘆不已

paragraphs.text: Janosch Abel challenges flashy sports photography by immortalising the repetitive labour that truly shapes an athlete
paragraphs.translation: 雅諾什·阿貝爾挑戰華而不實的運動攝影，將真正形塑運動員的重複勞動定格為永恆

paragraphs.text: Where are all the female falconers? Lauren Maccabee photographs the girls choosing bird-rearing over social media
paragraphs.translation: 女性獵鷹人在哪裡？勞倫·馬卡比拍攝了那些選擇育鳥而非社交媒體的女孩

paragraphs.text: Silvana Trevale’s photographs of Venezuelan youth are a love letter to a generation growing up in uncertainty
paragraphs.translation: 西爾瓦娜·特雷瓦萊拍攝的委內瑞拉青年照片，是寫給在不確定性中成長的一代人的情書

paragraphs.text: Fancy a bit of It's Nice That in your inbox? Sign up to our newsletters and we'll keep you in the loop with everything good going on in the creative world.
paragraphs.translation: 想在您的收件匣中看到一些 It's Nice That 的內容嗎？訂閱我們的電子報，我們將讓您了解創意世界中發生的一切好事。

quiz.sentence: Success often depends on maintaining a positive ____ even when facing failures.
quiz.sentence_zh: 成功往往取決於即使在面對失敗時也能保持積極的心態。

quiz.sentence: The detectives found tiny ____ of DNA at the crime scene.
quiz.sentence_zh: 偵探在犯罪現場發現了微小的 DNA 痕跡。

quiz.sentence: The joy of a summer sunset is beautiful but ____.
quiz.sentence_zh: 夏日落日的喜悅很美好，卻是稍縱即逝的。

quiz.sentence: I was so focused on the main character that I completely ____ the clues in the background.
quiz.sentence_zh: 我太專注於主角，以至於完全忽視了背景中的線索。

quiz.sentence: The old factory building was ____ many years ago and is now covered in vines.
quiz.sentence_zh: 那座舊工廠建築多年前就被遺棄了，現在長滿了藤蔓。

quiz.sentence: The novel's ending was full of ____, leaving readers to decide the hero's fate.
quiz.sentence_zh: 這部小說的結尾充滿了模稜兩可，讓讀者去決定英雄的命運。

quiz.sentence: Rice and beans are ____ in many Latin American households.
quiz.sentence_zh: 米飯和豆類是許多拉丁美洲家庭的主食（主打產品）。

quiz.sentence: The detective story was full of ____ that kept me reading until midnight.
quiz.sentence_zh: 這個偵探故事充滿了引人入勝的神秘感，讓我一直讀到午夜。

quiz.sentence: Don't worry about the store being far away; it's ____.
quiz.sentence_zh: 別擔心商店很遠，它就在附近。

quiz.sentence: The artist tried to ____ the feeling of loneliness in her latest painting.
quiz.sentence_zh: 這位藝術家試圖在她最新的畫作中描繪孤獨感。
